prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. EDIT the first image, the approved "elemental altar" main-menu concept. Preserve its front-facing symmetrical stone shrine, large teal circular arch with six elemental medallions (three left and three right), two restrained flame braziers, bronze chamfered stone controls, ivory fantasy serif, working title "Карточная дуэль", rich illustrated teal background, and the central hierarchy of main actions. Opaque landscape 16:9. Make ONLY the requested functional re-layout, expanding the deck preview area as necessary; don't invent another concept.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is supporting reference for the actual in-game nine-card deck and recognizable card frames; DON'T copy its collection-screen layout. Image 3 is a close-up creature reference for Златокрылый страж, Image 4 for Страж Первой Горы, Image 5 for Каменный жук. Only these THREE creatures belong in this deck: no spark fox, griffin or new creature.
REQUEST 1: Remove the ENTIRE bottom difficulty and fast-animation strip, including all their text, selectors, toggles. Replace it with one smaller centered bronze-edged button with a gear icon and exact label "Настройки". Settings are CLOSED. Do not display "Сложность ИИ", "Быстрые анимации", "Обычная" or "Выкл" anywhere on this screen.
REQUEST 2: Remove the three huge random decorative cards. Instead show the SELECTED DECK'S ACTUAL NINE CARDS, all nine fully countable, all nine front faces visible, none hidden behind buttons. Place the working title at top, then the selected-deck title bar "Земля и Свет" with "9 / 9", then a wide tidy horizontal gallery of exactly NINE portrait mini-cards across the upper-middle shrine, grouped subtly as 3 fields + 3 creatures + 3 abilities. The selected deck bar and nine cards form a single coherent deck-preview unit. Use almost the whole middle width between the elemental ring medallions so the nine cards are large enough; reduce side medallions and shrine padding if needed. Keep cards upright with minimal gaps, no overlapping fan obscuring card faces. Labels legible; each card should have restrained lower nameplate and colored rarity trim. No body rules text needed in miniatures.
NINE CARDS IN THIS EXACT LEFT-TO-RIGHT ORDER:
1 field "Горная тропа": rocky mountain path scene, common bronze/stone rim.
2 field "Родовая крепость": ancestral stone fortress scene, epic purple accented rim.
3 field "Зал смирения": solemn blue-lit stone hall scene, legendary gold rim.
4 creature "Каменный жук": warm ochre rock-armored beetle matching reference image5, power135, common.
5 creature "Златокрылый страж": white and golden winged guardian matching reference image3, power195, epic.
6 creature "Страж Первой Горы": towering amber rocky guardian matching reference image4, power260, legendary.
7 ability "Своя земля": glowing earth/territory sigil artwork, common.
8 ability "Разрыв условия": purple broken magical seal artwork, epic.
9 ability "Манёвр": golden swirling movement/arrow artwork, legendary.
Field and ability illustrations are conceptual UI visuals for this mockup; do not substitute additional creature portraits for them. Exactly 9 portrait rectangles in the deck preview, no other trading cards anywhere else.
BELOW the gallery keep a clearly centered vertical stack of three large buttons: primary glowing button "Против ИИ" with crossed swords; secondary button "Вдвоём за одним экраном" with two-person icon; tertiary button "Коллекция" with card icon. Then the smaller "Настройки" button at bottom center. All controls comfortably within the frame, spacious enough for touch, balanced visual weight, no clipped or cramped labels. The card gallery must not overlap menu buttons. Preserve altar theme; no decorative foliage, leaves or vines. No currencies, ranks, shop, online multiplayer or unrelated UI. Render the exact Russian strings cleanly. Single finished revised screenshot, not a collage, no annotations.
